summary.title_hr: M. P. Thompson – Kralj Tomislav (službeni video)
summary.abstract_hr: Riječ je o službenom glazbenom spotu za domoljubnu pjesmu „Kralj Tomislav” M. P. Thompsona, a ne o razgovoru ili podcastu. Pjesma opisuje krunidbu kralja Tomislava na Duvanjskom polju kao prvu krunu u Hrvata i slavi ga kao ratnika i vladara koji je branio dom od osvajača. Refren ističe da se njegova slava proteže od Jadranskog mora do rijeke Drave i da je domovina još živa jer su je branili vitezovi novih vremena. Strofe spominju Tomislavov spomenik u Zagrebu, Osijek, Split i papin blagoslov, a završni dio spominje Bosnu, Posavinu i Hercegovinu. Transkript sadrži i nekoliko kratkih nepovezanih fragmenata govora te dijelove teksta koji odstupaju od objavljenih stihova, što upućuje na pogreške automatskog prepoznavanja govora.
key_points: Pjesma opisuje krunidbu Tomislava na Duvanjskom polju i ističe je kao prvu krunu u Hrvata.
Tomislav je prikazan kao hrabri knez, ratnik i vladar koji je branio dom od osvajača, zbog čega je njegovo ime dobilo vječni sjaj.
Refren naglašava da je sva zemlja od Jadranskog mora do rijeke Drave zemlja Tomislavove slave i da je domovina još živa zahvaljujući vitezovima novih vremena.
Stihovi spominju Tomislava na konju u Zagrebu, majku iz Osijeka koja sinu, čuvaru na Dravi, pjeva o njegovu junaštvu, te Split i papin blagoslov.
Završni dio pjesme spominje Bosnu, Posavinu i Hercegovinu te ponosnu obranu predaka.
Kratki fragmenti govornika SPEAKER_00 i SPEAKER_02, kao i nekoliko neobičnih rečenica unutar pjesme, nisu jasni iz konteksta i vjerojatno su posljedica pogrešaka automatske transkripcije.
summary.title_en: M. P. Thompson – King Tomislav (official video)
summary.abstract_en: It is an official music video for the patriotic song "Kralj Tomislav" by M. P. Thompson, and not a conversation or podcast. The song describes the coronation of King Tomislav on Duvanjsko polje as the first crown among the Croats and celebrates him as a warrior and ruler who defended the home from invaders. The chorus emphasizes that his glory extends from the Adriatic Sea to the Drava River and that the homeland is still alive because it was defended by knights of new times. The stanzas mention Tomislav's monument in Zagreb, Osijek, Split, and the Pope's blessing, and the final part mentions Bosna, Posavina, and Hercegovina. The transcript also contains several short, disconnected fragments of speech and parts of the text that deviate from the published lyrics, which points to automatic speech recognition errors.
key_points_en: The song describes the coronation of Tomislav on Duvanjsko polje and highlights it as the first crown among the Croats.
Tomislav is depicted as a brave duke, warrior, and ruler who defended the home from conquerors, which is why his name gained eternal splendor.
The chorus emphasizes that all the land from the Adriatic Sea to the Drava River is the land of Tomislav's glory and that the homeland is still alive thanks to the knights of new times.
The verses mention Tomislav on a horse in Zagreb, a mother from Osijek who sings to her son, a guard on the Drava, about his heroism, and Split and the pope's blessing.
The final part of the song mentions Bosna, Posavina, and Hercegovina, and the proud defense of the ancestors.
Short fragments of speakers SPEAKER_00 and SPEAKER_02, as well as several unusual sentences within the song, are not clear from context and are probably the result of automatic transcription errors.
